nodes.label: Local first personal assistant
nodes.rationale: Direct commands and local memory remain useful without a model or API key.

nodes.label: Shared desktop conversation and controls
nodes.rationale: Island reuses the existing conversation, confirmation, history and voice paths.

nodes.label: Shared executive cognition loop
nodes.rationale: Reuse cognition, reasoning, memory, notification and execution services instead of another brain framework.

nodes.label: Behavioral capability assessment
nodes.rationale: Measure useful assistant behavior; human inspired capabilities do not establish consciousness.

nodes.label: Source version and forget fencing
nodes.rationale: Withhold stale copied context when forgetting or commitment revisions invalidate source evidence.

nodes.label: Recall relevance limitations
nodes.rationale: Frozen live diagnostics found off target object and event retrieval despite preserved original wording.

nodes.label: Local only background cognition
nodes.rationale: Inquiry, cognitive review and notification review use local Ollama with no cloud fallback.

nodes.label: Validated command translation
nodes.rationale: Model proposed commands return to the local router and cannot approve their own actions.

nodes.label: Documentation continuity
nodes.rationale: The handoff links the current feature inventory, changelog and backlog for later implementation decisions.

nodes.label: Prediction verification feedback
nodes.rationale: Atomic single use feedback preserves the original prediction and teaches scoped future app ranking.

nodes.label: Actual attention task health
nodes.rationale: Real asyncio task liveness distinguishes startup failure, stopped work and legitimate attention or budget waits.

nodes.label: Source backed working memory
nodes.rationale: Use selected work and original reports from existing stores, with source version checks before and after generation.

nodes.label: Staged cognitive upgrade roadmap
nodes.rationale: Track implemented increments separately from planned capabilities and retain verification evidence.

nodes.label: Health and working context increment
nodes.rationale: Expose attention task health and durable review diagnostics without weakening existing attention or inference gates.

nodes.label: Supervised automation approval
nodes.rationale: Approve one observed input at a time; consume approval once and recheck page or window identity before execution.

nodes.label: Bounded cited research
nodes.rationale: Read at most six pages and retain quoted sources and uncertainty instead of claiming exhaustive research.

nodes.label: Prediction training change record
nodes.rationale: Replace the old manual training queue with saved prediction verification while preserving action permissions.

nodes.label: Native college editor change record
nodes.rationale: The separate Tkinter client adds responsive editing with drafts, stale edit refusal and shared backend stores.

nodes.label: Native college schedules client
nodes.rationale: A separate Tkinter window uses the existing local backend and shared class, faculty and deadline stores.

nodes.label: College service ownership
nodes.rationale: The desktop is an HTTP client; college services own validation and projections behind loopback API routes.

nodes.label: Frozen parser outcome corpus
nodes.rationale: Source inventory and frozen phrase examples detect missing actions and stale examples.

nodes.label: Bounded command audit coverage
nodes.rationale: Representative action recognition is a bounded audit rather than proof of every runtime parameter or sentence.

nodes.label: Command coverage continuation
nodes.rationale: Record action inventory, paraphrase examples and stateful regression evidence for subsequent work.

nodes.label: Production phrase registry
nodes.rationale: Canonical requests and alternative sentences remain tied to production parser and router behavior.

nodes.label: Representative paraphrase coverage
nodes.rationale: Canonical commands and explicit alternative sentences are checked against real feature parsers.

nodes.label: Parameter coverage limits
nodes.rationale: The inventory measures representative phrases rather than every action or every possible sentence.

nodes.label: Local command aliases
nodes.rationale: Equivalent supported requests remain available through local matchers when language AI is unavailable.

nodes.label: AI canonical command translation
nodes.rationale: Unfamiliar phrasing can be translated to an existing local command while the local router retains authority.

nodes.label: Shared selected commitment topic
nodes.rationale: A named saved commitment supports scoped short follow up questions across local chat and voice.

nodes.label: Receipt anchored date countdown
nodes.rationale: Recalculate calendar distance without reinterpreting an old relative date against the current day.

nodes.label: Model free math and science
nodes.rationale: Explicit computation commands produce local results or local errors without falling through to an LLM.

nodes.label: State planned procedural stories
nodes.rationale: Dijkstra search finds prerequisite valid actions and checks that the final world satisfies the story goal.

nodes.label: Evidence driven cognitive runtime
nodes.rationale: Meaningful events wake bounded review, retrieve evidence and keep historical outcomes distinct from intentions.

nodes.label: Shared inhibition and interruption governor
nodes.rationale: Autonomous questions share source checks, attention gates, spacing and durable interruption claims.

nodes.label: Offline capability catalog
nodes.rationale: Capabilities and usage guides work without a backend, microphone, network or model.

nodes.label: Target app handoff
nodes.rationale: Minimize the control center and verify the selected target window before submitting screen or desktop requests.

nodes.label: Native configuration catalogs
nodes.rationale: Contacts, routines, projects and modes use the existing local settings backend without executing their stored commands.

nodes.label: Stale edit and approval invalidation
nodes.rationale: Refuse stale writes and invalidate pending recipient or project proposals after relevant configuration changes.

nodes.label: Shared desktop startup lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Launchers and repeat activation use the existing lifecycle worker to start one backend and avoid duplicates.

nodes.label: Source bound integration evidence
nodes.rationale: Reconcile changing source snapshots before treating focused, native and final regression results as evidence.

nodes.label: Bounded saved source fingerprints
nodes.rationale: Compare saved disk content to startup and persisted manifests; this does not prove which code a running process loaded.

nodes.label: Coarse shared upgrade context
nodes.rationale: Only counts, fixed component labels, times and uncertainty enter prompts; paths, hashes and source text stay excluded.

nodes.label: Personal assistant feature surface
nodes.rationale: Default behavior concerns the owner's schedule, routines, preferences and observed activities.

nodes.label: Capability privacy boundaries
nodes.rationale: Existing channel permissions and exclusions keep private command payloads outside inappropriate model and history flows.

nodes.label: Island slash command routing
nodes.rationale: The advertised slash catalog is checked against actual Island and backend routing with controlled adapters.

nodes.label: Backend availability aware commands
nodes.rationale: Suggestions and execution reflect full backend, standalone plugin or offline native capability availability.

nodes.label: Native habit check in tracker
nodes.rationale: Scheduled check ins, reversible history and archives are separate from learned app usage habits.

nodes.label: Shared task workspace storage
nodes.rationale: The native desktop and normal commands share cognition database task records; completions remain owner reports.
